title: Mail Memories – A desktop app to rescue photos from Gmail
claim: Show HN: Mail Memories – A desktop app to rescue photos from Gmail
why_good: Mail Memories is a desktop app that scans your Gmail, extracts all photo attachments, and organizes them into a local, searchable archive. It stands out by automatically deduplicating and sorting photos by date, making it easy to rediscover and preserve your photo history.
value: Non-technical individuals who have years of photos in Gmail and want a simple way to back them up locally or to another service will pay for a one-time fee or subscription for the convenience and peace of mind.
risk: Google could easily add a 'download all photos' feature to Gmail, or users might already use Google Photos' auto-import, making this app obsolete.

zh.claim: Mail Memories 是一款桌面应用，能自动从 Gmail 附件中提取并整理照片，为你提供一个可搜索的本地照片档案。
zh.hook: 那些多年来在 Gmail 附件中积攒了珍贵照片、却难以查找或备份的人，正因担心失去这些回忆而痛苦。
zh.does: Mail Memories 是一款桌面应用，能扫描你的 Gmail，提取所有照片附件，并将它们整理成本地可搜索的档案。它的独特之处在于自动去重并按日期排序，让你轻松重新发现和保存照片历史。
zh.why_use: 与手动下载附件或使用通用邮件搜索不同，Mail Memories 提供了一种专用的自动化解决方案，节省大量繁琐时间，并确保不漏掉任何照片。它为你提供永久、本地的照片副本，不受 Gmail 存储限制或账户问题影响。
zh.gap: 目前的解决方案是桌面应用，需要技术设置（OAuth、本地安装），只有极客才能使用；没有面向普通用户的简单托管或移动版本。
zh.counter: Google Photos 已经自动备份手机照片，并能从 Gmail 导入，因此独立应用对许多用户可能多余。此外，Gmail 的搜索和下载功能足以满足偶尔需求，这使其成为小众工具。
zh.differentiator: 我会构建一个基于网页的版本，无需安装，只需点击“连接 Gmail”按钮，并提供“一键导出”到 Google Photos 或本地存储，面向非技术用户。
zh.value: 那些在 Gmail 中有多年照片、希望简单备份到本地或其他服务的非技术个人，会为这种便利和安心支付一次性费用或订阅费。
zh.risk: Google 可能轻易在 Gmail 中添加“下载所有照片”功能，或者用户可能已经使用 Google Photos 的自动导入，使此应用过时。
zh.why_good: Mail Memories 是一款桌面应用，能扫描你的 Gmail，提取所有照片附件，并将它们整理成本地可搜索的档案。它的独特之处在于自动去重并按日期排序，让你轻松重新发现和保存照片历史。

does: Mail Memories is a desktop app that scans your Gmail, extracts all photo attachments, and organizes them into a local, searchable archive. It stands out by automatically deduplicating and sorting photos by date, making it easy to rediscover and preserve your photo history.
why_use: Unlike manually downloading attachments or using generic email search, Mail Memories provides a dedicated, automated solution that saves hours of tedious work and ensures no photo is missed. It gives you a permanent, local copy of your photos, independent of Gmail's storage limits or account issues.
gap: No verified demand; the pain of extracting photos from Gmail is real but unproven, and existing solutions may already serve non-technical users.
counter: Google Photos already automatically backs up photos from your phone and can import from Gmail, so a standalone app may be redundant for many users. Also, Gmail's search and download features are adequate for occasional needs, making this a niche tool.
differentiator: I would build a web-based version that requires no installation, with a simple 'connect Gmail' button, and offer a 'one-click export' to Google Photos or local storage, targeting non-technical users.
hook: People who have years of precious photos buried in Gmail attachments, unable to find or back them up, are in pain because they fear losing these memories.
consumer_angle: Ordinary people with years of photos buried in Gmail could use a simple tool to reclaim them, but the need is not yet demonstrated.
pick_reason: No first-hand evidence of demand, and the space may already have adequate solutions.
